s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of bilateral ear pain and neck swelling following vaccination, with radiating pain and exacerbation by head movement, swallowing, and coughing
salient_findings: Bilateral ear pain radiating to the lateral and anterior neck and lower jaw
Abnormal thyroid function tests with suppressed TSH and elevated total T3 and free T4
key_facts: 42-year-old African American woman
History of stage IIIB colon adenocarcinoma
Paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
Iron deficiency anemia
Lumbar radiculopathy
Received Moderna mRNA COVID-19 vaccine
Pain started 5-6 days after each vaccine dose
No fever, fatigue, malaise, anorexia, myalgia, dysphagia, dysphonia, dyspnea, cough, rhinorrhea, lacrimation, or ear discharge
No history of thyroid disease, head or neck radiation, or family history of head and neck cancer
Vitals: T 35.9°C; HR 88/min; BP 111/75 mm Hg; RR 17/min; SpO₂ 97% on room air
Lab results: WBC 6.4×10³/µL; Hgb 13.2 g/dL; Plt 207×10³/µL; BUN 10 mg/dL; Cr 0.43 mg/dL; normal electrolytes and LFTs
Thyroid function tests: TSH <0.0005 IU/mL; total T3 1.90 ng/dL; free T4 1.51 ng/dL
ESR 81 mm/h
Thyroid ultrasound showed heterogeneous masses in both lobes and mildly enlarged left paratracheal lymph nodes

shortlist.label: Subacute thyroiditis
shortlist.why_kept: Acute onset of bilateral ear pain and neck swelling following vaccination, elevated ESR, and thyroid ultrasound showing heterogeneous masses

shortlist.label: Silent thyroiditis
shortlist.why_kept: Abnormal thyroid function tests (TSH <0.0005 IU/mL) and presence of heterogeneous masses on thyroid ultrasound

shortlist.label: Painful thyroiditis
shortlist.why_kept: Bilateral ear pain and neck swelling, worsened by head movement, swallowing, and coughing, with elevated ESR

shortlist.label: Hashimoto thyroiditis
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of thyroid peroxidase antibodies, although low, and heterogeneous masses on thyroid ultrasound

shortlist.label: De Quervain thyroiditis
shortlist.why_kept: Acute onset of neck pain and swelling, elevated ESR, and thyroid ultrasound showing heterogeneous masses, following vaccination
